description: List the custom attribute names in use across the account, each with its value type (string, number, or boolean), whether it holds a list (isArray), an example value, and how many of the sampled recent contacts carry it. Call this before add_subscriber or update_subscriber to reuse existing names and match their types, e.g. send a zip code as the string "02134" rather than a number. Names only older contacts carry are included with sampledContacts 0. mixedTypes is true when contacts hold different types for a key; valueType is then string. Always send values with leading zeros as strings, whatever valueType says.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

includeNested.description: Also list nested paths such as profile.tier. Defaults to false.

name: list_subscriber_attributes

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_subscriber_attributes` MCP tool.

attributes.description: Custom attributes in use, each with key, valueType (string, number, or boolean; string when mixedTypes is true), isArray, mixedTypes (contacts hold different types), sampleValue (null when no example is available), and sampledContacts (0 for names only older contacts carry).

items.description: One item in the returned collection.
Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

sampledContacts.description: Recent contacts with custom attributes that were sampled for types and examples.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
